newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finvest mulls listing Jaakko Poyry unit.
newsitem.headline: Finvest mulls listing Jaakko Poyry unit.

text.p: Finnish capacitor and engineering group Finvest said in a statement on Thursday it was investigating a listing of its forestry consulting and engineering unit Jaakko Poyry Group.
"Prerequisites for both Helsinki and Stockholm Stock Exchange listings are currently being investigated," it said, adding that Carnegie was its adviser.
Jaakko Poyry offers engineering, project management and consulting services worldwide, with core expertise in forest industry, energy environment protection and construction, Finvest said.

"According to the Engineering News Record Magazine, the Jaakko Poyry Group was the world's fifth largest consulting and engineering firm in 1995 in terms of foreign billings," it said. "In the forest products industry, it is a world market leader."
Finvest said Poyry's business operations developed better than planned in the first four months of the year, though net sales fell to 414.4 million from 437.6 million a year earlier.
Its January-April operating profit rose to 31.3 million from 29.4 million and the orderstock was 735.8 million, compared with 688.1 million in the year-ago period.
